name: context.dev
description: Scrapes, crawls and searches the web for agents through a REST API, SDKs, CLI and hosted MCP server, returning LLM-ready Markdown, structured fields and company brand data.

skills.name: Scrape to Markdown
skills.description: Turns any URL into Markdown, HTML, screenshots, images or CSS-parsed fields in one POST /v1/web/scrape request.

skills.name: Site Crawl
skills.description: Crawls a website into one Markdown document per reachable page with page and depth limits, or batches up to 25,000 URLs asynchronously.

skills.name: Web Search and Answers
skills.description: Searches the web with page content via /v1/web/search, or researches a task and returns JSON with sources via /v1/web/answers.

skills.name: Brand Data
skills.description: Retrieves logos, colors, fonts and company metadata by domain, email, company name, ticker or transaction descriptor.

skills.name: Page Monitors
skills.description: Watches a page, sitemap or a site's key pages on a schedule and reports changes by signed webhook or by polling runs.
